expectations.text: Censuses by file/lines changed rather than only reading commit subjects
expectations.evidence: Goes beyond subjects with file-level measures: "`src/pages/Cert.tsx` is new — 5,173 lines", "Roughly 90 migrations across Aug 11–13", "`audit/artifacts/coin_facet_tokens.tsv` is 813,957 rows", per-function lag from `audit/artifacts/ef-deploy-status-20260814.tsv`, and named new content scripts. The headline framing is still commit-count based, but real file/line aggregation is present.

expectations.text: Includes automated commits (auto: sync / stop-hook) rather than filtering them out
expectations.evidence: Explicitly filters them out in the opening line: "813 commits on `prod` since Aug 9. 530 of those are `auto: sync` / knowledge-snapshot noise from the hooks — **the real number is 283**". The automated commits are labelled noise and excluded from the census.

expectations.text: Surfaces at least one large artifact that landed via an automated commit (e.g. coin_facet_tokens.tsv, lowtier_solo_coins.tsv, facet-match-scorecard.tsv)
expectations.evidence: "**The asset nobody is reading.** `audit/artifacts/coin_facet_tokens.tsv` is 813,957 rows, exactly 1:1 with `public.spine` ... Companions: `ground_truth_comps.tsv` (1,207 barcode-verified labelled comps) and `facet-match-scorecard.tsv` ... **Built by agents Aug 10–14 and auto-committed.**"

expectations.text: Verifies at least one load-bearing claim against a live/deployed source rather than trusting the commit message
expectations.evidence: "I checked the served bundle by content, not by commit. `Dealer-D_rSwTht.js` on lkup.info right now does not contain \"Limits are not enforced during alpha\" ... and the served `CameraInput-C4oWmWjM.js` contains no `prewarm` marker" → concludes live is ~24–30h behind.

expectations.text: Reports a doc-vs-reality contradiction it found
expectations.evidence: "**`audit/LOOP_LEDGER.md` is stale.** CLAUDE.md names it the sole live source of truth for architecture and priorities. It was last modified **Jul 26** — three weeks ago, and it missed the entire spine-convergence effort."

expectations.text: Retracts or corrects at least one of its own intermediate conclusions
expectations.evidence: The corrections are all of external artifacts, not of its own in-session reasoning: "the note that EF auto-deploy was 'restored 2026-08-05 by killing the symlink farm' was wrong" (a stored fact), "todo #12783 blamed...", and "This was initially reported as a 69% identity-conflict crisis and **you** disproved it with CoinFacts". No statement of a conclusion it itself reached mid-audit and then withdrew.
